members.name: identityHue
members.description:
Identity seed: when set, a deterministic conic-gradient hue is derived
and applied to the initials tile. Same seed → same face across every
view that mounts the avatar. Use the agent id (or any stable identifier)
so the same agent renders identically on the list, wire view, detail
inspector, etc. Explicit `tone` still wins when set to a non-muted
value; `identity-hue` only activates when no explicit tone is applied.

declarations.description:
Typeahead string-buffer for listbox / menu / tree keyboard search.

Collects single-character keystrokes into a buffer that resets after
`timeout` ms of inactivity. `match(items, fromIndex)` returns the index
of the next item whose label starts with the buffer (case-insensitive),
preferring items strictly after `fromIndex` and wrapping. Returns -1 if
no match.

matches starting with that letter (Listbox APG pattern).
